summary: Accepted proposal for skill cleanup. The proposal preserves workflow/userflow semantics while aligning skill language with ADR-0004 and ADR-0006, RFC 2119, and skill authoring/script-first best practices. Deterministic topic validation passed and auditor PASS captured.
Plan is drafted, validated, auditor-approved, and ready for human approval before implementation starts.

P0 Inventory and Baseline complete. Captured stale/direct-write skill language, ADR-0004 delegation findings, line counts, and confirmed AGENTS.md guardrails plus .pi agent model updates are intentional user-requested local work. Main cleanup targets: proposal/plan/interview SKILL.md direct JSONL write wording; implement SKILL.md wrapper tightening; plan/proposal delegated prompts that imply canonical JSONL writes; interview wrapper/fallback gap.

P1 Skill-Language Checker complete. Added skills/plan/scripts/check_skill_language.py with --json/--strict, concise help, frontmatter description/model checks, line-count checks, direct canonical JSONL mutation detection, delegated write authority detection, and allowlists for prohibitions/tool output/fallback contexts. Added tests/test_check_skill_language.py fixtures and wired the checker into npm run check:scripts py_compile. Current project report intentionally finds 12 blocking stale skill-language findings for P2/P3 cleanup.

P2 Wrapper-First Rewrites complete after auditor-directed fixes. Proposal, plan, interview, and implement skills now route canonical writes through cartographer_proposal/cartographer_fact/cartographer_index slice-jsonl/cartographer_plan/cartographer_plan_status/cartographer_validation/cartographer_handoff/cartographer_receipt/cartographer_jsonl or explicit parent-owned CLI fallbacks with validation/receipts. Delegated mapper/researcher/planner language returns suggestions/prose for the parent to apply. Skill-language checker reports zero findings. Targeted rg reports only explicit prohibition/least-privilege/wrapper fallback examples; prettier warnings remain limited to pre-existing .cartographer schema formatting outside touched skill files.

P3 Delegation Boundary Review complete. Tightened cartographer-drafter to noncanonical draft/suggestion outputs only and cartographer-archivist to read-only/noncanonical fact suggestions; parent applies accepted canonical changes. Existing proposal/plan/implement language already marks scout/planner/worker/pathfinder paths as suggestions, prohibitions, or explicit fallback/legacy opt-in. cartographer-pathfinder remains deprecated legacy opt-in, not default. Auditor/compass are read-only; redactor writes only sanitized evidence outputs by design. Checker reports zero blocking delegation findings; targeted rg hits are allowed prohibition/least-privilege/fallback examples.
